name: Clear Vegetable Manchow Soup
ingredients: 1 tbsp each minced ginger and garlic
1 tbsp cornflour mixed with 3 tbsp water
steps: Heat the oil on high and fry ginger, garlic and chilli for 30 seconds.
Add carrot, beans, cabbage and mushrooms and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Pour in the stock and soy sauce and simmer for 8 minutes. Add the tofu.
Stir in the cornflour paste and simmer 2 minutes until the soup thickens slightly.
Finish with vinegar, pepper and spring onions. Serve at once.
note: A lighter take on Indo-Chinese manchow: no fried noodles, extra tofu and plenty of vegetables.
